verdict.rationale: The professional portal links to a fiscal calendar ("Voir le calendrier fiscal"), which points to published filing deadlines. Only one exact date appears, and it is for the online correction window for personal income declarations (29 July – 30 November 2026), not business filings. Nothing in the evidence covers late-filing penalties or interest rates. Missing for 10: the actual business filing deadline dates with exact figures, a published penalty schedule, a late-payment interest rate, and independent corroboration.
